response: Tymnet was an international data communications network headquartered in San Jose, CA that utilized virtual call packet switched technology and used X.25, SNA/SDLC, BSC and ASCII interfaces to connect host computers (servers) at thousands of large companies, educational institutions, and government agencies. Its business consisted of a large public network supporting dial-up users and a private network business that allowed government agencies and large companies to build their own dedicated networks.
expected: an international data communications network headquartered in San Jose, CA
